stimulus.title: Thông báo
stimulus.html:
Greenfield Public Library – Summer Hours

Beginning July 1, the Greenfield Public Library will open at 10:00 A.M. instead of 9:00 A.M. on weekdays. Closing time remains 8:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday and 6:00 P.M. on Friday. On Saturdays, the library will be open from 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M., and it will be closed on Sundays until September 1.

The change allows our staff to prepare for the Summer Reading Challenge, which begins on July 8. Children aged 6 to 12 can register at the front desk or on our Web site. Participants who read ten books by August 20 will receive a free ticket to the Greenfield Science Museum.

Local Tech Firm Expands

(May 3) Brightpath Software, a Dunmore-based company that develops scheduling apps for hospitals, announced yesterday that it will double its workforce over the next two years. The company, which was founded by former nurse Alicia Romero in 2017, currently employs about 120 people. — [1] —

According to Ms. Romero, the expansion is necessary because of growing demand from hospitals in Europe and Asia. — [2] — Brightpath plans to open an office in Berlin early next year. — [3] —

stimulus.title: Bài báo
stimulus.html:
City to Add Bike Lanes Downtown

The Harlow City Council voted on Tuesday to add protected bike lanes to four major downtown streets. The project, which will cost about $3.2 million, is expected to begin in July and finish by the end of the year.

Council member Diane Whitaker, who proposed the plan, said that the number of people cycling to work has risen by 40 percent in the past five years. Some local business owners have expressed concern that the project will remove nearly 100 parking spaces. In response, the city has promised to build a new parking garage on Fifth Street, which is scheduled to open next spring.
